raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions has 4958 rows but only 4814 distinct txn_ids, which are contiguous from 900001 to 904814. So the same txn_id is being re-delivered across daily batches, and silver has no dedup step. I'm keeping the latest delivered version of each txn_id (by ingest_ts, then batch_id) before filtering to POSTED, so a later REVERSED version also drops the txn.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
